title: DISRQAD: Diffusion Image Super-Resolution Quality Assessment Dataset and Benchmark
title_zh: DISRQAD: 基于扩散的图像超分辨率质量评估数据集和基准

paragraphs.en: Diffusion-based image super-resolution (SR) can create visually plausible detail that is not supported by the low-resolution input. We introduce DISRQAD, a subjective-quality dataset and diagnostic benchmark for this setting. It contains mean opinion scores (MOS) for 14,000 SR outputs from ten diffusion and four non-diffusion methods, spanning four low-resolution degradation conditions and × 2 \times 2 / × 4 \times 4 upscaling. We evaluate 51 standard full-reference and no-reference metric configurations and 11 adapted variants. Agreement with MOS is substantially weaker on diffusion outputs: the strongest standard no-reference baseline reaches 0.431 SRCC on diffusion SR versus 0.813 on non-diffusion SR. As a case study in benchmark use, a pruned and distilled Q-ReAlign-mini student reaches 0.496 SRCC on diffusion SR. DISRQAD measures perceived output quality, not faithfulness to the input; it enables analysis of metric behavior across generator families and input conditions. Our findings reveal a substantial gap in the assessment of diffusion-based SR and provide a basis for developing quality models sensitive to diffusion-specific artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: 基于扩散的图像超分辨率（SR）技术能够生成在视觉上令人信服但低分辨率输入中并不存在的细节。 我们提出了 DISRQAD，一个用于该场景的主观质量数据集和诊断基准。 该数据集包含来自十种扩散方法和四种非扩散方法的 14,000 个 SR 输出的平均意见分数（MOS），涵盖了四种低分辨率退化条件和 × 2 / × 4 的放大倍率。 我们评估了 51 种标准的全参考和无参考指标配置，以及 11 种经过调整的变体。 在扩散方法生成的输出上，与 MOS 的一致性明显更弱：最强的标准无参考基线模型在扩散 SR 上的 SRCC 仅为 0.431，而非扩散 SR 上则达到 0.813。 作为基准使用的案例研究，一个经过剪枝和蒸馏的 Q-ReAlign-mini 学生模型在扩散 SR 上达到了 0.496 的 SRCC。 DISRQAD 衡量的是感知到的输出质量，而非与输入的忠实度；它使得分析不同生成器家族和输入条件下指标的行为成为可能。 我们的研究结果揭示了评估基于扩散的 SR 时存在的显著差距，并为开发对扩散特有伪影敏感的模型提供了基础。

paragraphs.en: Super-resolution (SR) reconstructs high-resolution (HR) images from low-resolution (LR) inputs, with deep neural networks driving recent progress Yue et al. (2025) ; Chen et al. (2026) . However, SR methods can alter perceptually salient structures and introduce artifacts such as oversharpening, ringing, and unnatural textures Xie et al. (2023) ; Molodetskikh et al. (2026) . Reliable image quality assessment (IQA) is therefore needed to compare reconstructed images at scale and guide the development of SR methods Sheng et al. (2026) ; Chen et al. (2025b) . This task becomes particularly challenging when generated details look plausible but do not match the underlying scene. A mismatch between metric scores and human judgments can therefore distort comparisons between SR methods, even when they are evaluated on the same inputs.

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we use “diffusion-based SR” as an umbrella term for the evaluated generative restoration methods that employ diffusion- or flow-based priors. Diffusion-based Super-Resolution methods Yue et al. (2023) ; Wu et al. (2024b) ; Yu et al. (2024) have demonstrated promising performance by generating images of higher quality. However, they still struggle to reconstruct plausible structures and textures, often hallucinating objects or modifying highly salient regions, such as human faces. Several works study perceptual artifacts generated by various SR models, including diffusion ones Molodetskikh et al. (2026) ; Xie et al. (2023) ; Borisov et al. (2026b) . Because a visually attractive output may differ from both the LR evidence and the HR reference, neither fidelity to the reference nor appearance alone provides an unambiguous quality target. Figure 1 illustrates the range of perceived quality among diffusion-based SR outputs. In this work, we measure the visual quality of each output without showing raters its LR input or HR reference; fidelity to the underlying scene is a separate assessment target. This ambiguity may affect full-reference metrics, which penalize departures from the HR image, and no-reference metrics, which may reward plausible but unsupported detail. Human ratings are therefore needed to test how well existing IQA metrics rank generative SR outputs.

(2024) 通过生成更高质量的图像，展现了令人鼓舞的性能。 然而，这些方法在重建合理的结构和纹理方面仍存在困难，常常会出现物体幻觉或修改高度显著的区域（如人脸）。 多项研究探讨了各类超分辨率模型（包括扩散模型）所产生的感知性伪影 Molodetskikh et al. (2026) ; Xie et al. (2023) ; Borisov et al. (2026b) 。 由于视觉上吸引人的输出可能与低分辨率证据和高分辨率参考图像均存在差异，因此仅凭对参考图像的保真度或外观本身都无法提供明确的质量目标。 图1展示了基于扩散的超分辨率输出在感知质量上的差异范围。 在本项工作中，我们在不向评分者展示其低分辨率输入或高分辨率参考图像的情况下，测量每个输出的视觉质量；对原始场景的保真度则是一个独立的评估目标。 这种模糊性可能会影响全参考指标（因其会惩罚与高分辨率图像的偏离）以及无参考指标（因其可能奖励看似合理但缺乏依据的细节）。 因此，需要人类评分来检验现有的图像质量评估指标在排序生成式超分辨率输出方面的有效性。

paragraphs.en: IQA metrics can be broadly divided into three categories: Full-Reference (FR) Zhang et al. (2018) ; Wang et al. (2004) ; Kirillova et al. (2022) , Reduced-Reference (RR) Zheng et al. (2021) , and No-Reference (NR) Wu et al. (2024a) ; Agnolucci et al. (2024a) ; Ying et al. (2020) . FR metrics require access to an undistorted reference image, NR metrics estimate image quality using only the distorted image, whereas RR metrics rely on limited information extracted from the reference image. Recent studies Antsiferova et al. (2022) have shown that existing computational metrics exhibit only moderate agreement with human judgments. Furthermore, their limitations become even more pronounced when assessing super-resolved images Shi et al. (2019) . Existing subjective studies that include diffusion SR cover relatively few generative methods Chen et al. (2025b) ; Li et al. (2025) . It remains unclear whether the agreement between metric scores and human judgments is consistent across a broader range of generators and input conditions.
paragraphs.zh: IQA 指标大致可分为三类：全参考（FR）Zhang 等人（2018）；Wang 等人（2004）；Kirillova 等人（2022），部分参考（RR）Zheng 等人（2021），以及无参考（NR）Wu 等人（2024a）；Agnolucci 等人（2024a）；Ying 等人（2020）。FR 指标需要访问未失真的参考图像，NR 指标仅利用失真图像来估计图像质量，而 RR 指标则依赖从参考图像中提取的有限信息。近期的研究 Antsiferova 等人（2022）表明，现有的计算指标与人类判断的一致性仅处于中等水平。此外，在评估超分辨率图像时，这些指标的局限性会变得更加明显 Shi 等人（2019）。现有的包含扩散超分辨率的主观研究涵盖的生成方法相对较少 Chen 等人（2025b）；Li 等人（2025）。目前尚不清楚指标分数与人类判断之间的一致性是否在更广泛的生成器和输入条件下保持一致。

paragraphs.en: Therefore, one of the main objectives of this work is to determine which IQA metrics are most suitable for evaluating images produced by diffusion-based SR methods. We also investigate how well SR-specific IQA metrics perform on such data and analyze how fine-tuning on diffusion-generated images affects metric performance.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，本研究的主要目标之一是确定哪些图像质量评估（IQA）指标最适合评估基于扩散模型的超分辨率（SR）方法所生成的图像。 我们还研究了专为超分辨率设计的图像质量评估指标在这些数据上的表现，并分析了在扩散模型生成的图像上进行微调对这些指标性能的影响。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate IQA methods on generative SR, we first construct a diverse pool of LR inputs and outputs from ten diffusion and four non-diffusion SR methods. We then obtain MOS annotations for 10,000 diffusion and 4,000 non-diffusion outputs using more than 100,000 quality judgments. Finally, we compare 51 FR and NR IQA configurations against these human judgments and analyze the effects of SR-specific adaptation.
paragraphs.zh: 为了在生成式 SR 上评估 IQA 方法，我们首先从十种扩散型和四种非扩散型 SR 方法中构建了一个多样化的 LR 输入和输出集合。 接着，我们通过超过 10 万次质量判断，为 10,000 个扩散型输出和 4,000 个非扩散型输出获取了 MOS 标注。 最后，我们将 51 种 FR 和 NR IQA 配置与这些人类判断进行比较，并分析 SR 特定适配的影响。

paragraphs.en: Analysis and enhancement of representative IQA metrics: we fine-tune representative metrics on diffusion-SR specific data to evaluate how SR-specific training helps to align metrics with human visual perception.
paragraphs.zh: 代表性 IQA 指标的分析与增强：我们在扩散-SR 特定数据上对代表性指标进行微调，以评估 SR 特定训练如何帮助使这些指标与人类视觉感知保持一致。

paragraphs.en: Early SR-IQA datasets established human judgments as a basis for comparing reconstruction methods. CVIU-2017, QADS, and SISRSet vary algorithms and upscaling factors ( Ma et al., 2017 ; Zhou et al., 2019 ; Shi et al., 2019 ) ; RealSRQ adds captured low-resolution inputs ( Jiang et al., 2022 ) . SISAR extends coverage by inferring quality scores from a smaller set of direct ratings ( Zhao et al., 2022 ) . These datasets chiefly represent non-diffusion SR, where blur, ringing, and loss of detail are common quality concerns.
paragraphs.zh: 早期的 SR-IQA 数据集以人类判断为基础，用于比较不同的重建方法。 CVIU-2017、QADS 和 SISRSet 涵盖了多种算法和超分辨率放大因子（Ma et al., 2017；Zhou et al., 2019；Shi et al., 2019）；RealSRQ 则加入了实际采集的低分辨率输入（Jiang et al., 2022）。 SISAR 通过从较小的直接评分集合中推断质量分数，扩展了数据集的覆盖范围（Zhao et al., 2022）。 这些数据集主要代表非扩散型超分辨率技术，其中模糊、振铃效应和细节丢失是常见的质量问题。

paragraphs.en: Full-reference (FR) metrics compare an SR output with a high-resolution reference; no-reference (NR) metrics judge the output alone. In generative SR, synthesized texture may look natural but differ from the reference. FR metrics measure correspondence with that reference; NR metrics assess appearance without it.
paragraphs.zh: 全参考（FR）指标将超分辨率（SR）输出与高分辨率参考图像进行比较；无参考（NR）指标则仅根据输出本身进行判断。 在生成式超分辨率中，合成的纹理可能看起来自然，但与参考图像存在差异。 FR 指标衡量输出与参考图像的一致性；NR 指标则在缺乏参考图像的情况下评估其外观。

paragraphs.en: Full-reference metrics. FR methods do not share a single notion of correspondence. PSNR and SSIM reward pixel or structural similarity ( Wang et al., 2004 ) , whereas LPIPS and DISTS compare feature representations ( Zhang et al., 2018 ; Ding et al., 2022 ) . ERQA focuses on restored edges ( Kirillova et al., 2022 ) ; A-FINE considers the case of an imperfect reference ( Chen et al., 2025b ) . Their assumptions matter when SR synthesizes plausible detail that does not reproduce the reference texture.
paragraphs.zh: 全参考指标。 FR 方法并不共享单一的对应关系概念。 PSNR 和 SSIM 奖励像素或结构相似性（Wang 等，2004），而 LPIPS 和 DISTS 则比较特征表示（Zhang 等，2018；Ding 等，2022）。 ERQA 关注恢复的边缘（Kirillova 等，2022）；A-FINE 考虑了参考图像不完美的情况（Chen 等，2025b）。 当 SR 合成出看似合理但未能再现参考纹理的细节时，它们的前提假设就显得尤为重要。

paragraphs.en: No-reference metrics. NR methods differ in their supervision. NIQE models natural-scene statistics without human scores ( Mittal et al., 2013 ) ; MUSIQ learns from subjective ratings ( Ke et al., 2021 ) , while Q-Align and DEQA use vision–language representations ( Wu et al., 2024a ; You et al., 2025 ) . NeuralSBS learns SR preferences ( Khrulkov and Babenko, 2021 ) ; FGResQ combines scores and rankings for restoration ( Sheng et al., 2026 ) . These methods can assess appearance without an HR image, but cannot compare generated details with that image. Table 3 includes the full range of FR and NR metrics.
paragraphs.zh: 无参考指标。 无参考方法在监督方式上有所不同。 NIQE 无需人类评分即可建模自然场景的统计特性（Mittal 等，2013）；MUSIQ 从主观评分中学习（Ke 等，2021），而 Q-Align 和 DEQA 则使用视觉-语言表示（Wu 等，2024a；You 等，2025）。 NeuralSBS 学习超分辨率偏好（Khrulkov 和 Babenko，2021）；FGResQ 结合评分与排名进行图像修复评估（Sheng 等，2026）。 这些方法无需高分辨率图像即可评估外观，但无法将生成的细节与该图像进行比较。 表 3 包含了所有无参考和有参考指标。

paragraphs.en: We constructed four LR conditions per source and scale: resized inputs and inputs with blur, additive noise, or JPEG compression, at × 2 \times 2 and × 4 \times 4 . These yield 80,288 LR images. We applied ten diffusion and four non-diffusion SR methods, then selected 10,000 and 4,000 outputs, respectively, by clustering output features. Each output received a direct MOS via subjective comparison. The open part of DISRQAD is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/visualprior/DISRQAD . Further construction details appear in Appendix A .

paragraphs.en: Our final target is perceived output quality, not reconstruction fidelity. Assessors viewed each SR output without its LR input or HR reference and rated it on a five-category scale from “very poor” to “excellent.” We averaged the ratings to obtain MOS. Thus, a visually attractive but scene-inconsistent image may receive a high score.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的最终目标是感知输出质量，而非重建保真度。 评估者在查看每个超分辨率输出时，不会看到其低分辨率输入或高分辨率参考图像，并依据从“极差”到“优秀”的五级评分标准进行打分。我们将各评分取平均值以获得MOS。 因此，一张在视觉上吸引人但与场景不一致的图像可能会获得高分。

paragraphs.en: A 50-output pilot compared pairwise preference, FR ratings, and NR ratings; its limited sample motivated the selected NR protocol but does not establish general equivalence between protocols. Training and control items screened annotators. The final annotation collected at least 13 ratings per output, yielding more than 205,000 judgments from more than 80 observers. In the pilot’s vote-count analysis (Table 2 ), the 13-rating MOS had SRCC 0.983 with the 20-rating baseline (95% CI [ 0.970 , 0.990 ] [0.970,0.990] ); this measures agreement within that pilot, not uncertainty for every final MOS. Appendix B gives the protocol, categories, and pilot results.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate 51 standard FR and NR configurations, spanning conventional, learned, SR-oriented, and vision–language IQA, plus 11 adapted variants. Each standard configuration and its citation appear in Table 3 . We used each metric’s default preprocessing; lower-is-better scores were sign-reversed. SRCC measures ranking agreement and PLCC measures linear agreement with MOS, without nonlinear fitting. Correlations are computed separately on 10,000 diffusion and 4,000 non-diffusion outputs. The MOS-annotated DISRQAD subsets are used for evaluation: the adapted baselines are not trained on their MOS. The 110-image SRIQA-Bench set used to select the student checkpoint is a validation set, not an independent test set.

paragraphs.en: Agreement with MOS decreases substantially on diffusion SR. Across the 51 configurations in Table 3 , the median SRCC decreases from 0.65 on non-diffusion outputs to 0.27 on diffusion outputs, and the median PLCC decreases from 0.60 to 0.31. The decrease spans both FR and NR methods with widely different designs and supervision, rather than being confined to one metric family.

paragraphs.en: The strongest baselines narrow but do not close this gap. TOPIQ(FR) decreases from 0.81/0.79 SRCC/PLCC on non-diffusion SR to 0.40/0.42 on diffusion SR. These results show that neither access to an HR reference nor general-purpose learned quality representations alone ensures agreement with human judgments of diffusion SR. Q-Align’s comparatively strong performance without SR-specific adaptation motivates the metric developed in Section 6 .

paragraphs.en: The fine-tuned examples in the leaderboard further show that SR adaptation is not uniformly beneficial. Fine-tuning LPIPS-AlexNet changes diffusion SRCC only from 0.28 to 0.29, while LPIPS-VGG decreases from 0.30 to 0.27. MUSIQ improves on diffusion SR from 0.27 to 0.31 but decreases on non-diffusion SR from 0.60 to 0.50. A complete comparison of the adapted variants is therefore reported separately: improvements in one SR family should not be treated as evidence of transfer to the other.

paragraphs.en: All results described below are presented in Table 4 . Metric performance differs substantially between classic and diffusion-based SR. On classic outputs, Q-Align reaches an overall SRCC of 0.813, while TOPIQ-FR reaches 0.811. Their correlations on diffusion outputs fall to 0.415 and 0.397, respectively. This gap extends beyond the leading methods: overall SRCC is higher on classic SR for 60 of the 62 evaluated metric variants. Thus, strong performance on classic SR provides limited evidence that a metric will rank diffusion outputs according to human judgments.
paragraphs.zh: 下文描述的所有结果均列于表 4 中。 经典超分辨率（SR）与扩散模型 기반 超分辨率在指标表现上存在显著差异。 在经典输出上，Q-Align 的总体 SRCC 为 0.813，而 TOPIQ-FR 则为 0.811。 它们在扩散模型输出上的相关性分别降至 0.415 和 0.397。 这一差距甚至超过了领先方法：在评估的 62 种指标变体中，有 60 种在经典超分辨率上的总体 SRCC 更高。 因此，在经典超分辨率上的优异表现并不能充分证明某项指标能够根据人类判断对扩散模型输出进行排序。

paragraphs.en: The difficulty of quality prediction also varies substantially among diffusion SR generators. PassionSR and ResShift yield the highest within-method SRCC for 36 and 20 of the 62 metric variants, respectively. For example, Q-Align reaches 0.714 on PassionSR, while distilled Q-ReAlign-mini reaches 0.666 on PassionSR and 0.613 on ResShift. DiT4SR presents the opposite pattern: it produces the lowest within-method SRCC for 38 metric variants. CODSR and PASD are also challenging, with median SRCCs across metric variants of 0.135 and 0.158. The gap across generators shows why results pooled over all diffusion outputs should be accompanied by within-method correlations.
paragraphs.zh: 质量预测的难度在不同扩散超分辨率生成器之间也存在显著差异。 PassionSR 和 ResShift 在 62 种指标变体中分别对 36 种和 20 种实现了最高的方法内 SRCC。 例如，Q-Align 在 PassionSR 上的 SRCC 达到 0.714，而蒸馏后的 Q-ReAlign-mini 在 PassionSR 上的 SRCC 为 0.666，在 ResShift 上则为 0.613。 DiT4SR 呈现出相反的模式：它在 38 种指标变体中产生了最低的方法内 SRCC。 CODSR 和 PASD 同样具有挑战性，其跨指标变体的 SRCC 中位数分别为 0.135 和 0.158。 不同生成器之间的差异表明，为何汇总所有扩散模型输出的结果时，应同时提供方法内相关性分析。

Fine-tuning TOPIQ-FR raises its diffusion SRCC from 0.397 to 0.436, while its classic SRCC falls from 0.811 to 0.694. Distilled Q-ReAlign-mini achieves the highest overall diffusion SRCC (0.496) and retains a classic SRCC of 0.729. These findings motivate reporting results by SR family, generator, degradation, and scale alongside aggregate scores.

paragraphs.en: We fine-tuned five full-reference (FR) methods (AHIQ, LPIPS-AlexNet, LPIPS-VGG, PieAPP, and TOPIQ-FR) and five no-reference (NR) methods (ARNIQA, MUSIQ, LIQE, TOPIQ-NR, and Q-ReAlign-mini) on SRIQA-Bench. LIQE required a lower learning rate ( × 10 − 6 5\!\times\!10^{-6} ) to ensure convergence. paragraphs.en: Q-Align is a strong NR baseline but has 8.2B parameters. We use the 0.8B Q-ReAlign-mini ( Q-Future, 2026 ) as teacher and starting point, prune its language stack to obtain a 340M-parameter student, and combine a five-token quality head with a regression head. Hierarchical distillation on KonIQ-10K, KADID-10K, and SPAQ precedes SR adaptation on 990 SRIQA-Bench images with 248 general-IQA replay images. The remaining 110 SRIQA-Bench images are used for checkpoint selection. The architecture, losses, and training settings are in Appendix C . The student retains Q-ReAlign-mini’s visual encoder and reduces its 24 language modules to 12 by pruning two Gated DeltaNet modules from each four-module group; its vocabulary is restricted to 30 tokens. One head scores five ordered quality tokens and a second regresses a continuous score from the last hidden state. A learned convex combination gives the final prediction. This compact description makes the reported parameter and throughput changes interpretable; the layer matching, losses, and optimizer settings remain in Appendix C . Figure 3 summarizes the pruning and two-stage training.

paragraphs.en: We introduced DISRQAD, a human-annotated benchmark of 14,000 SR outputs from ten diffusion and four non-diffusion methods, with 205,578 quality judgments. We evaluated 51 standard IQA configurations and 11 adapted variants against mean opinion scores for perceived output quality. For 60 of the 62 evaluated variants, SRCC was lower on diffusion outputs than on non-diffusion outputs. This pattern occurs across full-reference and no-reference metrics, while its magnitude varies with the SR generator, input degradation, and upscaling factor. Performance on conventional SR alone, therefore, provides an incomplete picture of a metric’s suitability for generative SR.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 DISRQAD，这是一个由人类标注的基准数据集，包含来自十种扩散模型和四种非扩散方法生成的 14,000 个超分辨率（SR）输出结果，并附有 205,578 项质量判断。 我们评估了 51 种标准图像质量评估（IQA）配置以及 11 种经过调整的变体，并将其与感知输出质量的平均意见分数进行了对比。 在评估的 62 种变体中，有 60 种在扩散模型输出上的 SRCC 值低于非扩散模型输出。 这种模式在全参考和无参考指标中均存在，但其程度会因 SR 生成器、输入退化程度和超分辨率放大系数而异。 因此，仅基于传统超分辨率任务的性能表现，无法全面反映某项指标在生成式超分辨率中的适用性。

paragraphs.en: As a case study, our pruned and distilled Q-ReAlign-mini student reaches an SRCC of 0.496 on diffusion SR and 0.729 on non-diffusion SR with 340M parameters. The broader fine-tuning results show that adaptation can improve agreement with human ratings, but its effects differ across metrics and SR families. Together, DISRQAD and these analyses provide a basis for developing and testing quality predictors for generative SR. The benchmark measures perceived output quality; assessing whether synthesized details remain faithful to the LR input is a complementary direction for future work.

paragraphs.en: The source-selection portion of Figure 2 yields 10,036 selected images from the candidate pool. We collected images from KonIQ-10K, CoCo (train, test, val splits), AVA, FLIVE; resulting in more than 468,000 images. Then, SI (Spatial Information), blockiness Wu and Yuen (1997) , SAM Kirillov et al. (2023) , Q-Align numeric features, ARNIQA Agnolucci et al. (2024a) , and CLIP Radford et al. (2021) embeddings were calculated. SI characterizes the amount of detail and texture in the scene, blockiness evaluates how pronounced the artificial boundaries between adjacent image blocks are. As a feature of the SAM, we took the number of objects that the model detects in the image. Q-Align expresses not only the visual quality of the image, but also its aesthetic component, since it was trained on both of these tasks. If ARNIQA embeddings reflect information about image quality and visual distortions, then CLIP embeddings express semantic information about the image.

paragraphs.en: We set a goal to take the most diverse images in terms of semantics and the number of objects presented, their dimensional features, natural and artificial distortions, while achieving maximum structural complexity and visual and aesthetic quality in order to evaluate SR methods in a highly competitive environment. We employed a binning procedure to determine a percentage threshold T T at which the intersection of the top T % T\% of images ranked independently by SI and Q-Align most closely approximated the target sample size. Using the resulting quantile, we fixed the Q-Align threshold and, from the remaining candidate pool, selected the maximum SI threshold such that the resulting number of images was greater than or equal to 10,000. (2025) ) to ensure broad coverage of the current design space of diffusion SR models. The benchmark includes methods based on different diffusion formulations, network architectures, conditioning strategies, and training paradigms. Specifically, the selected models range from early diffusion-based restoration approaches (e.g., ResShift) to recent latent diffusion and foundation-model-based methods (e.g., PASD-SDXL, InvSR, CODSR).
paragraphs.zh: 我们选择了十种具有代表性的扩散模型超分辨率方法（ResShift Yue et al. (2023)、SinSR Wang et al. (2024)、SeeSR Wu et al. (2024b)、SUPIR Yu et al. (2024)、PASD、PASD-SDXL Yang et al. (2024)、InvSR Yue et al. (2025)），以确保对当前扩散超分辨率模型的设计空间进行全面覆盖。该基准测试涵盖了基于不同扩散公式、网络架构、条件策略和训练范式的多种方法。具体而言，所选模型的范围从早期的扩散模型修复方法（例如 ResShift）到近期的潜在扩散模型和基础模型驱动的方法（例如 PASD-SDXL、InvSR、CODSR）。

paragraphs.en: We designed the subjective protocol to rate perceived output quality at a feasible annotation cost. NR MOS does not measure content fidelity to the LR input or HR reference. paragraphs.en: In pairwise assessment, assessors select the better of two SR images, and the preferences are aggregated using the Bradley–Terry (BT) model Bradley and Terry (1952) . Choosing between two images is generally easier for non-expert assessors than assigning an absolute quality score. We compared SR outputs derived from the same GT image. However, exhaustive pairwise comparison requires a number of judgments that grows quadratically with the number of outputs per reference. Moreover, BT scores estimated independently for different reference images are not directly comparable across references. We therefore used pairwise assessment as a baseline for selecting the rating protocol, rather than for annotating the entire dataset.
paragraphs.zh: 在成对评估中，评估者会选择两张超分辨率（SR）图像中较好的一张，其偏好则通过 Bradley–Terry (BT) 模型（Bradley 和 Terry，1952）进行汇总。 对于非专家评估者而言，在两张图像之间做出选择通常比给出绝对质量分数更容易。 我们比较了基于同一张参考图像（GT 图像）生成的超分辨率输出结果。 然而，全面的成对比较所需的判断次数会随着每份参考图像对应输出数量的平方而增长。 此外，针对不同参考图像独立估计的 BT 分数无法在不同参考图像之间直接比较。 因此，我们将成对评估用作选择评分协议的基础方法，而非用于标注整个数据集。

Assessors assign each SR image a score from 1 to 5, with higher values indicating better quality, and the ratings are averaged to obtain its mean opinion score (MOS). Because assigning absolute scores can be difficult for non-experts, we evaluated both of the following protocols:

paragraphs.en: We initialize the student from the Q-ReAlign-mini 0.8B checkpoint. Like Q-Align, it receives an image and a fixed quality-assessment prompt. The student retains the visual encoder but reduces the language component of the Qwen3.5-VL backbone. Its 24 language modules form six repeated groups of three Gated DeltaNet modules followed by one full-attention module. paragraphs.en: The model predicts quality through two heads. The token head converts the probabilities of five ordered quality tokens into a score T T . The regression head applies a → 256 1024\!\rightarrow\!256 projection, GELU, dropout, a → 1 256\!\rightarrow\!1 projection, and a sigmoid to the last hidden state, producing a continuous estimate M M . The final prediction is the convex combination y ^ = α ​ T + ( 1 − α ) ​ M \hat{y}=\alpha T+(1-\alpha)M , where α \alpha is learned jointly with the model. This preserves Q-Align’s discrete quality representation while allowing direct regression to MOS.

paragraphs.en: In the first stage, the unpruned Q-ReAlign-mini teacher provides supervision at several levels of the network. We match every third visual-layer output using mean squared error (MSE), match every corresponding language-layer output using MSE, and minimize the KL divergence between the teacher and student full-attention maps. At the prediction level, we match the teacher score using MSE and its distribution over the five quality tokens using KL divergence.
paragraphs.zh: 在第一阶段，未经修剪的 Q-ReAlign-mini 智能体在网络的多层提供监督。 我们使用均方误差（MSE）匹配每第三个视觉层的输出，使用 MSE 匹配每个对应的语言层输出，并最小化智能体与学生模型的全注意力图之间的 KL 散度。 在预测层面，我们使用 MSE 匹配智能体的得分，并使用 KL 散度匹配其在五个质量标记上的分布。

sents.en: In the first stage, the unpruned Q-ReAlign-mini teacher provides supervision at several levels of the network.
sents.zh: 在第一阶段，未经修剪的 Q-ReAlign-mini 智能体在网络的多层提供监督。

paragraphs.en: The student is simultaneously trained against subjective labels from KonIQ-10K ( Hosu et al., 2020 ) , KADID-10K ( Lin et al., 2019 ) , and SPAQ ( Fang et al., 2020 ) , using the dataset splits adopted by Q-Align. The label-based terms comprise MSE between y ^ \hat{y} and MOS, an in-batch RankNet loss, and an ordinal loss over the levels { 0 , 0.25 , 0.5 , 0.75 , 1 } \{0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1\} . When MOS falls between two adjacent levels, their target probabilities are obtained by linear interpolation; the ordinal loss is the mean squared distance between their cumulative distribution and that of the five predicted tokens. An additional MSE term encourages the two heads to produce consistent scores. In total, the first-stage objective contains nine terms, weighted as follows: MOS 1.0, ranking 0.3, ordinal 0.2, head consistency 0.05, teacher score 0.4, teacher tokens 0.5, text features 0.02, visual features 0.01, and attention 0.01. We train for eight epochs with an effective batch size of 8 (physical batch size 2) and select the checkpoint with the highest validation SRCC.
paragraphs.zh: 该智能体同时基于 KonIQ-10K（Hosu 等人，2020）、KADID-10K（Lin 等人，2019）和 SPAQ（Fang 等人，2020）的主观标签进行训练，并采用 Q-Align 所使用的数据集划分方式。 基于标签的损失项包括 y ^ \hat{y} 与 MOS 之间的 MSE、一个批内 RankNet 损失，以及对等级 { 0 , 0.25 , 0.5 , 0.75 , 1 } \{0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1\} 的序数损失。 当 MOS 值落在两个相邻等级之间时，其目标概率通过线性插值得到；序数损失则是其累积分布与五个预测标记的累积分布之间的均方距离。 一个额外的 MSE 项用于促使两个头生成一致的分数。 总体而言，第一阶段的目标函数包含九项损失，权重分配如下：MOS 1.0、排序 0.3、序数损失 0.2、头一致性 0.05、教师分数 0.4、教师标记 0.5、文本特征 0.02、视觉特征 0.01 和注意力 0.01。 我们以有效批量大小为 8（物理批量大小为 2）训练八个周期，并选择验证集 SRCC 最高的检查点。

sents.en: The student is simultaneously trained against subjective labels from KonIQ-10K ( Hosu et al., 2020 ) , KADID-10K ( Lin et al., 2019 ) , and SPAQ ( Fang et al., 2020 ) , using the dataset splits adopted by Q-Align.
sents.zh: 该智能体同时基于 KonIQ-10K（Hosu 等人，2020）、KADID-10K（Lin 等人，2019）和 SPAQ（Fang 等人，2020）的主观标签进行训练，并采用 Q-Align 所使用的数据集划分方式。

sents.en: The label-based terms comprise MSE between y ^ \hat{y} and MOS, an in-batch RankNet loss, and an ordinal loss over the levels { 0 , 0.25 , 0.5 , 0.75 , 1 } \{0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1\} .
sents.zh: 基于标签的损失项包括 y ^ \hat{y} 与 MOS 之间的 MSE、一个批内 RankNet 损失，以及对等级 { 0 , 0.25 , 0.5 , 0.75 , 1 } \{0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1\} 的序数损失。

sents.en: When MOS falls between two adjacent levels, their target probabilities are obtained by linear interpolation; the ordinal loss is the mean squared distance between their cumulative distribution and that of the five predicted tokens.
sents.zh: 当 MOS 值落在两个相邻等级之间时，其目标概率通过线性插值得到；序数损失则是其累积分布与五个预测标记的累积分布之间的均方距离。

sents.en: An additional MSE term encourages the two heads to produce consistent scores.
sents.zh: 一个额外的 MSE 项用于促使两个头生成一致的分数。

sents.en: In total, the first-stage objective contains nine terms, weighted as follows: MOS 1.0, ranking 0.3, ordinal 0.2, head consistency 0.05, teacher score 0.4, teacher tokens 0.5, text features 0.02, visual features 0.01, and attention 0.01.
sents.zh: 总体而言，第一阶段的目标函数包含九项损失，权重分配如下：MOS 1.0、排序 0.3、序数损失 0.2、头一致性 0.05、教师分数 0.4、教师标记 0.5、文本特征 0.02、视觉特征 0.01 和注意力 0.01。

sents.en: We train for eight epochs with an effective batch size of 8 (physical batch size 2) and select the checkpoint with the highest validation SRCC.
sents.zh: 我们以有效批量大小为 8（物理批量大小为 2）训练八个周期，并选择验证集 SRCC 最高的检查点。

paragraphs.en: The second stage removes the teacher and adapts the student to SR. Its training set combines 990 SRIQA-Bench images with 248 images from the three general-IQA datasets. SRIQA-Bench assigns MOS to both SR outputs and the corresponding HR images. Its 1,100 rated images were split at the individual-image level. The objective retains the first four label-based terms and adds L2 regularization toward the first-stage checkpoint with weight 10 − 4 10^{-4} . Both stages use AdamW with weight decay 0.01, 5% linear warm-up followed by cosine decay, and learning rates 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} , 2 × 10 − 6 2\times 10^{-6} , and 10 − 4 10^{-4} for the language, vision, and head parameters, respectively. This stage runs for two epochs with an effective batch size of 8 (physical batch size 4). The remaining 110 SRIQA-Bench images are used as validation for checkpoint selection.
paragraphs.zh: 第二阶段移除了教师智能体，并让学生智能体适应 SR。 其训练集结合了 990 张 SRIQA-Bench 图像和来自三个通用 IQA 数据集的 248 张图像。 SRIQA-Bench 为 SR 输出和对应的 HR 图像都分配了 MOS。 其 1,100 张已评分的图像是在单张图像层面进行划分的。 该目标函数保留了前四个基于标签的项，并添加了朝向第一阶段检查点的 L2 正则化项，权重为 10^{-4}。 两个阶段均使用 AdamW，权重衰减为 0.01，采用 5% 的线性预热，随后是余弦衰减；语言、视觉和头部参数的学习率分别为 2×10^{-5}、2×10^{-6} 和 10^{-4}。 该阶段运行两个周期，有效批量大小为 8（物理批量大小为 4）。 剩余的 110 张 SRIQA-Bench 图像被用作验证集以选择检查点。

sents.en: The remaining 110 SRIQA-Bench images are used as validation for checkpoint selection.
sents.zh: 剩余的 110 张 SRIQA-Bench 图像被用作验证集以选择检查点。

paragraphs.en: Starting from the SRIQA-Bench-adapted checkpoint, we further fine-tune the student on the open part of DISRQAD, following the same fine-tuning strategy used for SRIQA-Bench. We then evaluate it on the held-out private portion. On the 4,000 diffusion SR images in the private split, the model achieves an SRCC of 0.761 and a PLCC of 0.773. On the 1,600 non-diffusion SR images, it achieves an SRCC of 0.890 and a PLCC of 0.879. These results demonstrate that learning to predict perceived quality in the diffusion SR domain is feasible. The remaining performance gap relative to non-diffusion SR indicates that diffusion outputs pose distinct assessment challenges, motivating further domain-specific adaptation, specialized architectures, and systematic study.
paragraphs.zh: 从 SRIQA-Bench-adapted 检查点开始，我们遵循用于 SRIQA-Bench 的相同微调策略，在 DISRQAD 的开放部分上进一步对学生模型进行微调。 然后，我们在预留的私有部分上对其进行评估。 在私有分割集中的 4,000 张扩散 SR 图像上，该模型实现了 0.761 的 SRCC 和 0.773 的 PLCC。 在 1,600 张非扩散 SR 图像上，它实现了 0.890 的 SRCC 和 0.879 的 PLCC。 这些结果表明，学习预测扩散 SR 领域中的感知质量是可行的。 与非扩散 SR 相比，剩余的性能差距表明，扩散输出带来了独特的评估挑战，这促使我们进行更多领域特定的适配、采用专门的架构，并开展系统性研究。

paragraphs.en: DISRQAD focuses on the perceived visual quality of SR outputs under a no-reference protocol. Faithfulness to the LR input and semantic preservation are complementary assessment targets. The benchmark emphasizes detailed, high-quality source images and controlled single-degradation inputs, so applying its findings to compound real-world degradations calls for separate evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: DISRQAD 关注的是在无参考协议下 SR 输出结果的感知视觉质量。 对 LR 输入的保真度与语义保留是相互补充的评估目标。 该基准测试强调细节丰富、高质量的源图像以及受控的单次退化输入，因此要将其研究结果应用于复合的真实世界退化情况，就需要进行单独的评估。
